message: Security review: the guard classified an agent's DROP TABLE of a quoted table name as drop_table and built a safe plan whose step 1 (signed, run with no conditions) is: DELETE FROM _deprecations WHERE target = 'tmp_import'; DROP TABLE customers; --'; INSERT INTO _deprecations VALUES('tmp_import'; DROP TABLE customers; --', 1792900319, 'via blast-radius'). Running that step executes DROP TABLE customers.
